identity_basis.reviewer: Codex assistant, not a component expert
identity_basis.evidence: Same N80286-10 / SX004 markings, lower lot line, corner mould marks and visible wear in all three photos; Sgroey source series dated 2025-01-31 at 14:33:46, 14:31:06 and 14:29:00. Same physical unit is inferred from visible/source consistency, not confirmed by the owner.
identity_basis.limitations: One physical-unit hypothesis; mainly scale/framing changes and limited viewpoint variation. Low-resolution target crops from multi-chip comparison photos, not a dedicated close-up capture set. No population-level accuracy claim.
